package domain_test

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestNewTeacherGeneratedResponseAcceptsStrictBoundedResult(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	response, err := domain.NewTeacherGeneratedResponse(domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{
		ExecutionID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TemplateCode: domain.TeacherResponseTemplateCode, TemplateVersion: 1,
		ProviderCode: "openai", ProviderModel: "teacher-model", LanguageCode: "ru",
		ResponseSchemaCode: domain.TeacherResponseSchemaCode, Body: "  Проверь границу цикла.  ",
		CreatedAt: now, ExpiresAt: now.Add(time.Hour),
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "Проверь границу цикла.", response.Body)
}

func TestNewTeacherGeneratedResponseRejectsWrongContractIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	_, err := domain.NewTeacherGeneratedResponse(domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{
		ExecutionID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TemplateCode: "caller-selected", TemplateVersion: 1, ProviderCode: "openai", ProviderModel: "model",
		LanguageCode: "ru", ResponseSchemaCode: domain.TeacherResponseSchemaCode, Body: "body",
		CreatedAt: now, ExpiresAt: now.Add(time.Hour),
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration)
}
